checks.note: Authentication page confirms x-api-key header, host api.waterfall.io, master key needed for sub-keys; no OAuth mentioned. The homepage x-waterfall-api-key remark was not verified.

Authentication and Evaluate pages both say to contact support@waterfall.io for API access, test plan and pricing. They do not mention a free trial or self-serve signup. The skills page says installing a skill does not create an account or give API access. Whether a signup flow exists outside the docs is not settled.

Docs index lists 13 REST-style endpoints (async and sync) on api.waterfall.io: Prospector, enrichment, search, Job Change, Email Verification, webhooks, reporting and key management. Default rate limit of 50 requests per 60 seconds is confirmed on the rate-limit page. 'Moderate' is a judgment call.

The cited skills page does not mention MCP. It describes two official API skills (waterfall-direct-api, waterfall-integration) in a GitHub repo. llms.txt and a web search found no official or community Waterfall.io MCP server. Workato's 'Waterfall Lead Enrichment' MCP is a different product. 'none_found' stands, but the cited URL should point to the skills page as context, not as proof of no MCP.
Blocked follows from no self-serve credentials. The blocker text is consistent with the pages, and the 13 endpoints and 50 per 60 seconds figures are confirmed.

corrected.one_liner: Waterfall aggregates 30+ B2B data vendors behind one API for contact, email, phone and company enrichment, prospecting, contact search and job-change tracking.
corrected.auth_notes: Static API key sent in the x-api-key header to https://api.waterfall.io. A master key can create sub-keys. No OAuth documented. The marketing homepage shows x-waterfall-api-key in some examples, but the docs say x-api-key.
corrected.access_notes: The docs do not describe self-serve key creation. The Authentication and Evaluate pages both say to contact support@waterfall.io for API access, a test plan and pricing. The homepage CTA is "Book a Call". Pricing is usage-based with no amounts published. No free tier, trial or sandbox is mentioned. It is not confirmed whether a signup flow exists outside the docs.
corrected.blocker: No self-serve credentials. A developer must contact Waterfall sales/support to get an API key. The API itself is documented and agent-friendly: 13 endpoints, 50 requests per 60 seconds by default, async jobs with webhooks.
